verdict_rules: Corrected when the value asserts anything (including one clause of a compound value) that its own cited source page does not support for this plant and no sibling row with the same claim_id carries it; citation-only errors still count as corrections.

A plant-specific deployment or relationship needs a source naming the plant or a single-site company; otherwise the tag must be inferred.

Company-level product and capability statements are accepted for a plant when the company's own site names this plant as its (main) plant, or the page is site-specific, and no sister site is described as making a different line (applies to MICA 491/814/1499, Millerbernd 340-342, LaX 372/378).
